verification.subject: Confirm your e-mail address for Scacelith Test Server
verification.text:
Hello alice,

Welcome to Scacelith Test Server. To confirm your e-mail address and start playing online, open
this link and press the confirmation button:

https://play.example:8443/verify-email?token=AbC

The link is valid for 24 hours. If you did not sign up, ignore this message:
without the confirmation nothing is created or confirmed.

-- 
Scacelith Test Server
This is an automatic message; replies are not read.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your Scacelith Test Server password
passwordReset.text:
Hello alice,

Someone (hopefully you) asked to reset the password of your Scacelith Test Server account.
To choose a new password, open this link:

https://play.example/reset-password?token=xyz

The link is valid for 60 minutes and can be used once. Resetting the password
signs out every device. Two-step verification, if enabled, stays enabled.

If you did not ask for this, ignore this message: your password does not change.

-- 
Scacelith Test Server
This is an automatic message; replies are not read.

registrationAttempt.subject: Someone tried to register on Scacelith Test Server with your e-mail address
registrationAttempt.text:
Hello bob,

Someone tried to create a new Scacelith Test Server account with your e-mail address. Your
address already belongs to your account, so no new account was created.

If it was you, you can simply log in. If you forgot your password, use "Forgot
password" in the game to receive a reset link.

If it was not you, you do not need to do anything.

-- 
Scacelith Test Server
This is an automatic message; replies are not read.

registrationAttemptEmailChange.subject: Someone tried to use your e-mail address on Scacelith Test Server
registrationAttemptEmailChange.text:
Hello bob,

A player of Scacelith Test Server asked to change the e-mail address of their account to yours.
Your address already belongs to your account, so it was not given to theirs, and your
account did not change.

You do not need to do anything.

-- 
Scacelith Test Server
This is an automatic message; replies are not read.

Hello erin,

You asked to use this e-mail address for your Scacelith Test Server account. To confirm it, open
this link and press the confirmation button:

https://h/confirm-email-change?token=T

The link is valid for 24 hours and can be used once. Until it is used, your account

emailChangeRequested.subject: A change of your Scacelith Test Server e-mail address was requested
emailChangeRequested.text:
Hello erin,

On Mon, 28 Sep 2026 14:03:05 GMT, a change of the e-mail address of your Scacelith Test Server account
to n***@example.org was requested, with your password. The address changes only if the
link sent to the new address is opened within 24 hours; until then, this address stays
the one of your account.

If it was you, there is nothing else to do.

If it was not you, someone knows your password: change it at once in the game, or reset it
with "Forgot password". A new password cancels the change of address.

--

ssoAccountCreated.subject: A Scacelith Test Server account was created with your Google account
ssoAccountCreated.text:
Hello frank,

The Scacelith Test Server account "frank" was created with Google sign-in, with the Google
account of this address, on Mon, 28 Sep 2026 14:03:05 GMT.

If it was you, there is nothing else to do.

If it was not you, someone else may be signed in to it: sign in with Google in the game,
use "Sign out everywhere" on the account page, and contact the administrator of Scacelith Test Server.
Never send anyone the address your browser shows after a sign-in.

-- 
Scacelith Test Server
This is an automatic message; replies are not read.

ssoLinked.subject: Google sign-in was added to your Scacelith Test Server account
ssoLinked.text:
Hello grace,

Google sign-in was added to your Scacelith Test Server account "grace" on
Mon, 28 Sep 2026 14:03:05 GMT, with your password. From now on, the Google account of this address
signs in to it without the password.

If it was you, there is nothing else to do.

If it was not you, someone knows your password: change it at once in the game, or reset it
with "Forgot password", then use "Sign out everywhere" on the account page and contact the
administrator of Scacelith Test Server.

-- 
Scacelith Test Server
